quiet: Farmers in Red Deer gathered in the fall of 2017 to discuss the drought.
We spent the evening on the north shore of the lake in light rain.
The university in Saskatoon announced a new research chair last winter.
Early one spring morning we saw two moose crossing the gravel road.

notes: Top 32: ',' x15; the strongest are dateline commas after a year, plus fronted-phrase commas and setting words ('back here', 'первое время'). A probe confirmed a dateline comma (0.68) and also 'back here' (0.42), so this label covers only part of the pole. Near misses keep dates but not in a dateline-plus-comma position.
